title: 면접에 떨어진 친구 위로하기: 기분이 안 좋아 보여요
objective: Use -아/어 보이다 to notice how a friend looks, and comfort them.
summary: A friend notices someone looks down and comforts them.
setting: A café after work. Jisu notices that her friend Michael looks down.

task.title: Notice, then comfort
task.line: Use the words and the -아/어 보이다 pattern from page 1 to complete each item.

words.meaning: to look, to seem (said about what you can see)
words.example: 그 가방 무거워 보여요. 제가 들어 줄게요.
words.exampleMeaning: That bag looks heavy. Let me carry it for you.

words.meaning: to feel upset, to be hurt inside
words.exampleMeaning: I was upset because my friend forgot our plans.
I failed the driving test again.

words.meaning: to be a shame, to feel sorry that something didn't happen
words.example: 콘서트 표를 못 사서 너무 아쉬워요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's such a shame I couldn't get concert tickets.

words.example: 저도 한국에 처음 왔을 때 외로웠어요. 그 마음 알아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I was lonely when I first came to Korea too. I know how you feel.

words.example: 다음 달에 기회가 또 있으니까 걱정하지 마세요.
words.exampleMeaning: You'll get another chance next month, so don't worry.

words.meaning: to cheer up, to keep going
words.example: 시험이 얼마 안 남았어요. 조금만 더 힘내세요!
words.exampleMeaning: The exam is coming up soon. Keep going a little longer!

dialogue.korean: 마이클 씨, 오늘 기분이 안 좋아 보여요. 무슨 일 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Michael, you look a bit down today. Is something wrong?

dialogue.korean: 지난주에 본 면접 결과가 나왔는데, 떨어졌어요.
dialogue.meaning: The results of last week's interview came out, and I didn't get it.

dialogue.korean: 아, 정말 속상하겠어요. 준비 많이 했잖아요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, you must be really upset. You prepared so much.

dialogue.korean: 네, 정말 열심히 준비했는데 너무 아쉬워요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I prepared really hard, so it's such a shame.

dialogue.korean: 그 마음 알아요. 그래도 너무 실망하지 마세요. 기회는 또 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: I know how you feel. Still, don't be too disappointed. There will be other chances.

exercises: Change the word in brackets into the -아/어 보이다 form: ① (피곤하다) 어젯밤에 잠을 못 잤어요? 얼굴이 ____. ② (슬프다) 무슨 일 있어요? 눈이 좀 ____.
Choose the best reply. Your friend says: 아끼던 지갑을 잃어버렸어요. (a) 와, 잘됐네요! (b) 정말 속상하겠어요. (c) 저는 지갑이 두 개 있어요.

Fill in each blank with the right word from the box (떨어지다 / 아쉽다 / 힘내다) in the polite -아/어요 form (use the past tense where needed): ① 열심히 공부했는데 대학원 시험에 ____. ② 비 때문에 여행이 취소돼서 정말 ____. ③ 시험이 일주일 남았어요. 조금만 더 ____!
Answer in Korean with two sentences. Your friend says: 한국어 말하기 대회에서 상을 못 받았어요. Comfort them using 속상하다 and 기회.
answers: ① 피곤해 보여요 ② 슬퍼 보여요
① 떨어졌어요 ② 아쉬워요 (아쉬웠어요) ③ 힘내요 (힘내세요)
정말 속상하겠어요. 그래도 기회는 또 있어요. (또는: 많이 속상하죠? 다음에 또 기회가 있을 거예요.)
